notes: Base prices are off-peak; windows are the peak rates (2x). Official peak is 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC, Monday-Friday, excluding Chinese public holidays; the schema cannot express weekdays or holidays, so weekend and holiday hours in those windows are over-estimated at peak rates. Per the official changelog (https://api-docs.deepseek.com/updates), time-of-day pricing took effect 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC and the V4.1-Flash prices 2026-09-10 04:00 UTC; the 2026-10-17 model update left pricing unchanged. effective_date is 2026-09-10, the date from which all models here carry current prices (table selection is by date, so the hour offset is approximated). 2026-08-16 to 2026-09-09 is not covered: deepseek-v4-pro there had current prices but is priced by the older table, and the then-current Flash prices were not confirmed from text. deepseek-v4-flash is a retired legacy name billed at Flash prices.
